label: Initial employee and action API views
instruction: Generate one concise DRF APIView file, maximum 100 lines. ApplicationListView GET calls list_applications(request.principal) serialized many=True, POST validates LeaveApplicationSerializer and calls submit_application. BalanceListView GET own_balances. TaskListView GET assigned_tasks. ApplicationActionView POST calls act_on_application(request.principal, pk, request.data.get("action"), request.data). Use supplied actual service names exactly, serializers and HasModuleGrant("leave_elm")/HasPermission for the matching existing registry permission interfaces. Return Response serialized model or errors via supplied platform handler. Synchronous views. No new logic in views or models.
